approach: Native C++ reimplementation: game logic is rebuild from the original game's own data (event programs, object tables), rendered with Direct3D 9 and XAudio2 on Xbox 360. No original assets or code are included; you supply your own copy.
help: Gameplay logic for FNAF 3, FNAF 4 and Sister Location
notes: Xbox 360 ports of the classic Five Nights at Freddy's games. FNAF 1 is complete, FNAF 2 is about 90%, FNAF 3 and 4 are in progress, Sister Location has only the startup flow.
